subject: En Route Cannabis Delivery Community Outreach
overview: En Route Home Delivery presented a proposal for a 100% minority-owned, delivery-only cannabis warehouse located at 151 Mystic Avenue. The meeting detailed the firm's operational security, environmental commitments, and a labor peace agreement focused on local hiring.

items.title: Business Proposal Presentation
items.summary: Brian Keith detailed the delivery-only model which utilizes a warehouse and an all-electric fleet to distribute pre-packaged products, noting that the site will have no public component or retail sales. The proposal includes 40 jobs with a Medford hiring preference and a signed labor peace agreement with UFCW Local 1445.

items.title: Community Testimony and Q&A
items.summary: Labor representatives and residents expressed support for the project's equity goals, while neighbors clarified that the facility would not involve on-site processing or displacement of existing businesses.

items.title: Regulatory Timeline and Next Steps
items.summary: The applicant outlined the process for moving from community outreach to a Cannabis Advisory Committee review and a formal Host Community Agreement with the Mayor's office.
